def polygon_area(sides):
    n = len(sides)

        return 0
    # Using the Shoelace formula to calculate the area of a polygon
    area = 0
    for i in range(n):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        area += sides[i] * sides[j]
    return abs(area) / 2

def is_valid_polygon(sides):

    n = len(sides)
    for i in range(n):

    return True
